optimization_unit.name: Exact-V8 component-relative existing-signal strength suppression
optimization_unit.question: Can a complete, non-cherry-picked map of component-relative monotone signal-strength gates suppress weaker exact-V8 entries enough to repair early temporal loss and reduce whole drawdown while preserving whole and recent stressed value?
optimization_unit.mechanism_boundary: Every exact-V8 strategy, signal formula, direction and evaluation timestamp remains active. A candidate may only raise the acceptance floor on the component's already logged native feature and thereby refuse a subset of exact-V8 signal-passed births.
optimization_unit.independence_from_unit_002: Unit 002 changed component membership, executable weights and component-local post-loss state. Unit 003 fixes all five exact-V8 members, exact weights, position risk and aggregate cap, and changes only within-component strength admission before the unchanged portfolio admission path.

frozen_future_inputs.role: exact-V8 signal feature and admission context

input_staging_boundary.rule: No input copy, config, executable proxy implementation, derived threshold table or result may be created until this declaration commit is verified on origin/main.

this_unit_is_limited_to: Hard monotone suppression of weaker exact-V8 signal-passed births
Coarse complete map, fine adjacency, one-component causal ablations, fresh validation and temporal/cost stability
optimization_scope.new_entry_strategy_definition: Any new symbol, timeframe, signal family, direction or opportunity timestamp not emitted by exact V8, including a threshold below the exact-V8 native gate or another entry loosening that manufactures an opportunity.

outcome_free_threshold_construction.population_rows: research-candidates rows for the named component with signal_known=1 and signal_passed=1 inside the population period, including both POSITION_OPEN and aggregate-risk-blocked paths
outcome_free_threshold_construction.neutral_meaning: Use the exact native gate; do not replace it with the empirical minimum.
outcome_free_threshold_construction.positive_quantile_rule: Sort finite normalized strengths ascending. For q > 0, select the nearest-rank value at one-based rank ceil(q * N), clipped to 1..N. Candidate passes when normalized_strength is greater than or equal to that frozen value.
outcome_free_threshold_construction.ties: Keep all equal-to-threshold rows. Deduplicate roles by exact five-value threshold vector while preserving all quantile/seed provenance.

shared_executable_proxy_contract.risk_capital: minimum of actual balance, stressed balance and source pre-order risk-capital haircut applied to actual balance

ordered_deep_stages.enumeration: Cartesian product of three frozen quantile coordinates over RC61, RC64, Cross, Intraday and Return. The all-zero vector is the exact-V8 neutral. Every role retains all five components, exact weights, formulas, directions, timestamps, risk and cap.
ordered_deep_stages.deduplication: Deduplicate exact five-threshold vectors caused by empirical ties while preserving all quantile provenance. Canonical order is lexicographic quantile vector, then exact threshold vector.

eligibility.common: Each of the four development half-years must have positive actual net, positive stressed net and positive minimum balance.
eligibility.primary: Continuous development stressed net retains at least 75% of exact-V8 development stressed net and actual closed-balance DD is no more than 27%.
eligibility.fallback: Continuous development stressed net retains at least 65% of exact-V8 development stressed net and actual DD improves by at least five percentage points versus exact V8.
eligibility.robustness: An eligible unique role needs at least four eligible immediate one-coordinate neighbors spanning at least three component axes. Immediate means one 0.25 lattice step while the other four coordinates are equal.

ordered_deep_stages.center_selection: Use primary if nonempty, otherwise fallback. Rank robust roles by highest weakest development-half stressed net, whole stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, whole stressed net, lower DD, then canonical order. Select at most three with differences on at least two component coordinates; fill by rank only if separation prevents three.
ordered_deep_stages.no_eligible_fallback: If no robust eligible role exists, advance up to three separated valid near misses by normalized sum of four half-year sign deficits, stressed-retention deficit and DD deficit, then efficiency and canonical order. Near-miss advancement preserves mandatory depth but is not economic confirmation.

ordered_deep_stages.local_quantile_rule: For each center component q, use unique coordinates max(0,q-0.10), q and min(0.60,q+0.10). Recompute thresholds by the same frozen outcome-free nearest-rank rule.
ordered_deep_stages.deduplication: Deduplicate exact threshold vectors across all centers while retaining center/quantile provenance.
ordered_deep_stages.eligibility: Use Stage-A common, primary and fallback gates unchanged. Eligible fine-neighbor robustness requires at least four eligible one-local-step neighbors spanning at least three component axes in at least one shared center provenance.
ordered_deep_stages.center_selection: Use Stage-A tier, ranking, separation and at-most-three rules. If there is no robust eligible point, advance declared near misses by the same normalized-deficit rule.

ordered_deep_stages.roles_per_center: One immutable Stage-B center plus one diagnostic ablation for each component whose center quantile is above zero; the ablation returns only that component to exact-V8 native gate q=0.
ordered_deep_stages.ablation_selection_rule: No ablation may replace, retune or rescue its immutable center. It tests whether one suppressed component is unnecessary on fresh data.
ordered_deep_stages.fresh_validation_gate: The immutable center begins from fresh $100 and must have positive actual net, positive stressed net, positive minimum balance, DD no greater than 30% and stressed-net retention at least 65% of exact V8 for January-May.
ordered_deep_stages.causal_nondominance_gate: The center fails if any one-component native-gate ablation has stressed net at least as high and DD no higher, with at least one strict difference. Equal arithmetic is not domination.

ordered_deep_stages.cost_book: Judge actual net and the already recorded doubled-observed-cost stressed net; fit no new cost model.
ordered_deep_stages.block_gate: Every block begins independently at $100 with the immutable thresholds and must have positive actual net, positive stressed net, positive minimum balance and actual closed-balance DD no greater than 30%.
ordered_deep_stages.whole_gate: Continuous 2024-01 through 2026-07 replay must retain at least 75% of exact-V8 whole stressed net and improve actual closed-balance DD by at least five percentage points.
ordered_deep_stages.ranking: Among roles passing every gate, maximize weakest block stressed net, then whole stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, whole stressed net, lower whole DD and canonical order. Locked holdout never selects an alternate.
ordered_deep_stages.empty_input_rule: If Stage C has zero validation-passing immutable centers, record all declared blocks as zero-input/zero-run and close U003 validly empty; do not reopen an ablation, neighbor or near miss.

ordered_deep_stages.conditional: Exactly one unchanged Stage-D winner may enter.
ordered_deep_stages.purpose: Establish native freed-capacity admissions, open-equity DD, stop quantization and full Tester economics that the accepted-source proxy cannot claim.
ordered_deep_stages.authority: A native result can close or support U003 but cannot modify or promote Live directly.

closure_and_correction_rules.economic_closure: Only after Stages A through D are completed as declared and no immutable Stage-D survivor exists, or after the sole valid Stage-E finalist nonconfirms with no declared layer remaining.
closure_and_correction_rules.required_after_closure: Freeze the whole Unit bundle, then recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before opening any successor.
